crusadecraft.codex.territoire.p0: Land is counted in $(l)chunks$(), as in Factions: the circles around towns, forts and guard posts take the chunks whose centre lies inside, and what you paint or claim is added. Every map draws the same squares.$(br2)$(l)/crusade claim$() [radius] claims, $(l)/crusade unclaim$() releases, $(l)/crusade map$() shows nearby chunks, $(l)/crusade info$() tells who owns this one.
crusadecraft.codex.territoire.p1: Crossing a border shows the realm's name in large letters. On a player realm's land, only its own people break, place and open chests; a vassal or liege too, an ally opens doors, an enemy at war sets up ladders. Inside a colony, MineColonies permissions apply. Computer realms' lands are open unless configured otherwise.
